keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 photo of a small home kitchen at night, seen from standing height in the middle of the room, looking at the kitchen counter. The room lights are off. Cool blue moonlight comes in through a window above the sink, and a small warm lamp under the range hood on the left gives a soft orange glow. At the horizontal center of the frame is a stainless steel sink with a faucet in a pale wooden counter, with a dish rack, a bottle of dish soap and a cutting board on the counter. Below the sink is a pale wooden two-door cabinet. Its left door is half open, and the dark open gap of the cabinet is at the horizontal center of the frame, in the lower third of the frame. Through the gap, a white plastic drain pipe and the dim inside of the cabinet are just visible. A tiled floor fills the bottom of the frame. Realistic photo, natural colors, deep focus. Keep everything important away from the left and right edges. No people, no animals. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. The camera has moved forward through the half-open cabinet door into the cabinet under the sink. Show a close-up of the back corner inside the cabinet, behind the white plastic drain pipe, seen at a slight downward angle. The cabinet floor is damp pale wood-grain board with small water stains and a few crumbs, and it fills the lower 55 percent of the frame. The back wall of the cabinet is an old cream-white board. Where the floor meets the back wall, a thin dark gap runs horizontally across the frame at 45 percent of the frame height. The white drain pipe with its U-bend stands vertically in the right third of the frame. Warm dim light from the kitchen falls in from the open door on the left; the rest is soft shadow, but the floor and the wall are clearly visible. On the floor, right at the gap, stands one large adult female American cockroach (Periplaneta americana), seen from above and the side, her body horizontal with her head to the left. She is glossy reddish-brown, with long wings that cover the whole abdomen, a pronotum with a pale yellow band around its edge and two dark brown blotches in the middle, very long thin antennae and spiny legs. A dark reddish-brown purse-shaped egg case sticks out from the tip of her abdomen under the wing tips. The egg case is one quarter of her body length and has a serrated ridge along its top edge. Her abdomen tip with the egg case touches the gap at the horizontal center of the frame. Her body, without the antennae, is about one third of the frame width long. She is not a German cockroach. Only one cockroach. Macro photo, sharp focus on the cockroach. No text, no watermark.

Edit this image. Keep the cabinet floor, the back wall, the dark gap, the drain pipe, the lighting and camera angle exactly the same. The cockroach is gone. Only the dark reddish-brown egg case remains, lying tucked into the gap where the floor meets the back wall, in exactly the same place as before at the horizontal center of the frame, with its serrated ridge on top. No cockroach. No text, no watermark.
